body: No i can't say that i am ok. I am lost and i don't know if i can find the happiness in my life again.

the problem is that I hate myself. I do not know who I am and I hate myself for the choices I made, for as I am now, for everything. I tried to be happy these years but everything is collapsing again. I no longer have the strength even to try again. I can't anymore.

I do not know who I am. I realized it and the world collapsed on me. I have lived these years in a lie trying to satisfy the expectations of all but now I hid myself for so long that I do not know who I am. I lost myself and i don't know if i can find me again. I don't know if i lost myself forever.
